## Four problems, four patterns

- **Productive workflows with Positron** — making the most of your IDE

- **Design once, use anywhere** — one brand, every format

- **Build reusable structures** — the meta data around your content

- **Why Typst matters** — a PDF you can restyle

## Which piece for which job? 

- `_brand.yml` — the **same look** across formats and projects.
  One repo, not a theme per project.

- Template partials — the **same structure**, different content.
  Format specific, and driven by metadata.

## What we did not get to 

**Lua filters** — change the document while Pandoc holds it as an AST.

Not format specific, so one filter can serve `html`, `typst`, and `revealjs`.
Reach for one when the change you want is to the *content*, not the boilerplate
around it.

[Extending Quarto →](https://posit-conf-2025.github.io/quarto-extend) — a whole
workshop on filters, shortcodes, and extensions
